name: Climb a Ramp!
desc:
🔥 Welcome to Climb a Ramp!

💸 Climbing the ramp gives you money!
⚠️ Remember to avoid the obstacles in your path!
⚡ Upgrade your SPEED + CASH to earn more!

🎁 Use code "RELEASE"!
❤️ Use code "20K"! Thank u all for 20k members in the group!

👍 Like the game and join the group for MORE UPDATES!

💻 Available on Desktop, Mobile & Tablet!
